{{Short description|American psychologist}}
'''Lawrence J. Hubert''' (born 23 May 1944) is an American psychologist and statistician.

Hubert earned a doctorate from [[Stanford University]] under [[Lee Cronbach]] and [[Patrick Suppes]], and held professorships in psychology (later as [[Lyle H. Lanier]] Professor) and statistics at the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Lawrence J. Hubert |url=http://www.psychology.illinois.edu/people/lhubert |accessdate=17 December 2018 |publisher=University of Illinois–Urbana Champaign}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Lawrence J. Hubert |url=https://stat.illinois.edu/directory/profile/lhubert |accessdate=17 December 2018 |publisher=University of Illinois Urbana–Champaign}}</ref> Hubert was elected a foreign member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 2007.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/foreign-members/7403 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200425221757/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/foreign-members/7403 |title=Lawrence Hubert |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=25 April 2020}}</ref> The [[Psychometric Society]] gave him the Career Award for Lifetime Achievement in 2015.<ref>{{cite news |title=Lawrence Hubert wins 2015 award for lifetime achievement! |url=https://www.psychometricsociety.org/content/lawrence-hubert-wins-2015-career-award-lifetime-achievement |accessdate=17 December 2018 |publisher=Psychometric Society |date=2015}}</ref>
